description: This file defines a static class for diagnostics related to generating code for declaring assembly attributes in the Orleans code generator. It includes constants for diagnostic IDs, titles, messages, and a method to create diagnostics based on attribute data and type symbols.

classes.name: GenerateCodeForDeclaringAssemblyAttribute_NoDeclaringAssembly_Diagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostic constants and a method to create diagnostics related to missing declaring assemblies in attributes.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object for the given attribute and type, indicating an error when a type lacks a declaring assembly.
